Fix round 2 is done, but phase 6 still isn't passed: two High findings are open and both need your input. I didn't run the production image build or the clean-host test after the `tsc` fix.

| Finding | Result |
|---|---|
| F-V14 (High) | Fixed in `38aa018`: the unused test parameter was renamed. `tsc` is clean and vitest passes 377 of 377. |
| F-V15 (Medium) | Fixed in `38aa018`: prettier is clean on the 8 test files. |
| F-V17 (Medium) | Fixed in `f552ccf`: the approved `pom.xml`, frozen-test and manifest changes are committed, and D-67 records the springdoc `-api` licence. `licence-check.mjs` now passes. |
| F-V16 (High) | Not reproduced. `audit.mjs` passes, and `image-size` and `nodemailer` aren't in the lockfile (D-69). |
| F-V07 (Medium) | Left as an open item for the release notes (D-69). |
| F-V13 (High) | Open (D-70). The backend re-scan ran: swagger-ui is gone and the three Spring Security CVEs are covered by your earlier acceptance. 12 Spring Framework 6.2.19 CVEs (up to 9.8) are still unassessed. |
| F-V01 (High) | Open (D-68). I couldn't find a cause from the case categories alone, and I changed no code. |

**F-V13:** you can allow a web search of those advisories, name a Spring Boot 3.5.x version, or accept them per CVE.

**F-V01:** my hypothesis is that held-out browser tests meet the Slovenian default and expect English labels. The visible tests select English through a `localStorage` key (`language`) that no input names. This is unconfirmed. Switching the default for English browsers would break R-018-01, so that is your call.

You can answer D-68 and D-70 with `/fix D-68: n D-70: n`. The handover points to `/verify` as the next step, and it can run before you answer.

The decisions, report resolutions and handover are committed in `13d2b4b`.
